intro: Katie Hunter is a horse breeder stationed at the stables in the Eastvale Logging Camp within eastern Elwynn Forest. She provides trained riding horses and steeds to citizens of Stormwind and trusted champions of the Alliance. Alongside Randal Hunter, she ensures travelers and soldiers have reliable mounts to navigate the kingdom's roads.

p: Tucked away in the quiet, wooded clearings of the Eastvale Logging Camp, Katie Hunter manages the kingdom's primary horse stock for aspiring riders in Elwynn Forest. While the lumberjacks harvest timber for Stormwind's reconstruction, Katie tends to the stables, raising a variety of dependable breeds including pintos, mares, and swift steeds. Her stock represents the classic equestrian tradition of the kingdom, offering faithful companions capable of braving dangerous roads across southern Azeroth.
